rows.en:
"Golden Mask never dies… he only fades away!"

That line bothers me…
What bothers me more is the Black Cross Fuhrer…
Yeah, you're right.
Why would that invincible man… suddenly hole up in a shelter?
Cassiopeia… That's definitely what he said, isn't it? That Apfaron guy…
Yes… that's definitely what he said.
Cassiopeia… What does it mean?
What could it mean, I wonder…

It doesn't mean anything!

If you eat, you pay! That's just common sense.

…!?

Could it be!?
What's that? You figured somethin' out?

The "Ka" from Kaijo, the "Shi" from Shinmei, the "O" from Oiwa, the "Pe" from Peggy, and the "A" from Asuka…

Put the first sounds of everyone's names together and you get "Ka-shi-o-pe-a"… Cassiopeia, don't you?
Mr. Tachibana… that's a bit of a stretch.

…!?

Hey, could it be!?

The "Ka" from Kaijo, the "Shi" from Shinmei, the "O" from Oiwa, the "Pe" from Peggy, and the "A" from Asuka…

Put the first sounds of everyone's names together and you get "Ka-shi-o-pe-a"… Cassiopeia, right?
Haah…
No time to sit around! I gotta tell everybody…

Hey!

…Geez, what a hopeless guy.

Still… good on her for thinking of that! Cassiopeia, huh…

Hm…? Cassio-PAY-a? "Cash I owe, pay… ah, forget it"? What? So they really are a bunch who won't pay their tab!
According to the Tokyo Observatory's report, strong cosmic rays were falling at exactly that time.

According to what the radio telescope in Cambridge, England, picked up…

at the same time… radio waves and X-rays discharged from Alpha Cassiopeiae rained down on Earth for about 30 minutes.
Radio waves and X-rays from Alpha Cassiopeiae…
Intense radio waves and X-rays are discharged from Cassiopeia from time to time.
Could it be… that the Black Cross Fuhrer is weak against those cosmic rays?
I see… That's why that man said "Cassiopeia" back then!
That's it… The Black Cross Fuhrer is weak against them!
Hm? But we have no proof! We mustn't jump to conclusions…
Cassiopeia…
Okaaay, here comes Doctor Riddle!

About that Cassiopeia… Kaijo, Shinmei, li'l ol' Oiwa, Peggy, Asuka… take the first sounds of us five and it's Cassiopeia!

Cassiopeia's the five stars of Gorenger, I tell ya!
Hahaha, I see…
By the way, Commander… there's a strange rainbow out up above, I tell ya! It's shinin' gold!
Hm!? What? A golden rainbow?

…!?

Commander, Black Cross Castle is approaching!
What!? It must have something to do with that rainbow…
Could it be Golden Mask…?

Come to think of it… that gold dust on our bodies just wouldn't come off.

It's making a rainbow with radiation to show them where our secret base is!
It seems a rainbow has appeared.

Ooh, it's appeared!?

That's the rainbow Golden Mask raised by burning away his life! Under that rainbow lies the Gorengers' secret base! Now, all-out attack!
The golden rainbow is right around here… In other words, the Gorengers' secret base must be in this area, no doubt about it.
All right, carpet bombing! Smash the Gorenger base in one go!!
"Golden Mask never dies"… "he only fades away."
But he really got us… That gold dust was Golden Mask's soul!
Taking his own life to find the enemy's secret base… a true Great General.
The Gorenger base is wrecked… We can't go home even if we wanted to. We're driftin' crows now.
The Black Cross Army will come to deliver the final blow any minute! If that happens, we're in trouble…
But, Commander… the Varidreen only has enough fuel left to fly for about 10 more minutes!
Then we can't even fight in the air.
Damn it, what do we do!?
The one key is the connection between Cassiopeia and the Black Cross Fuhrer.
But… even that isn't certain…
Then we just have to test it!

…!?

Test it?
I'll meet the Black Cross Fuhrer and test it.
Halt! Where do you think you're going?
I've got a gift for His Excellency the Fuhrer!
So you've finally given up? Tsuyoshi Kaijo… no, Akarenger!
Our base is destroyed, and we have nowhere to go…

Look at the horoscope…

Mars is in retrograde, entering Scorpio.

But… I have repelled that ill fortune by force!
Don't relax just yet. Mars has passed Scorpio… and is now in the House of the Moon! Look!
What does that mean?

According to the teachings of ancient Babylon…

when Mars is in the House of the Moon and a lunar eclipse occurs, the emperor dies and his nation falls!
Indeed… such a legend does exist, I suppose…

Heh heh heh… Nonsense, nonsense. Didn't I just tell you? I repelled that ill fortune by force…

Our Black Cross Army is eternal and immortal! Hah hah hah…
This! …I'd like to present it to His Excellency!
What is it?
Open it…
No reaction for explosives.
Open it!
Aaah!?
Uwah… Aaaaagh! It's Cassiopeia!?
It's just a tiny light bulb!!
What!?
Why are you… so afraid of Cassiopeia?
You tested me, didn't you!? Seize him!
We found it! The Fuhrer's weak point!
Roger! All right, let's go!!
Have you come to die!? Gorengers!! Kill them!!
Hoi!!
Nuoooooh…
All right… Now's our chance to defeat the Black Cross Fuhrer!! Let's go!!

uncertain: U14512/U14515/U14529: the Cassiopeia acronym (Ka-shi-o-pe-a from the five members' surnames) explained via romanized syllables.
U14513: polite-variant reaction 'ちょっと、苦しいです' read as HERO4 calling something a stretch; the line it reacts to is not obvious (possibly Tobei's pun in U14518). Could also mean 'I can't breathe'.
U14518: Tobei's pun カシオパア → 貸しをパア (debts wiped out) recreated loosely as 'Cassio-PAY-a'.
U14528-U14547: Daita Oiwa's Kyushu dialect (ばい/たい/じゃのう) rendered with folksy English.
U14531: 総指令 read as 総司令 (Commander).
U14544: 旅ガラス rendered 'driftin' crows'.
